sources.title: EDGE
sources.snippet: Almost half the U.S. population is unserved or underserved by traditional risk-scoring methods that look only at past payments and balances of credit accounts as a proxy for future risk. By looking beyond a credit score, EDGE provides insight into financial activities and behaviors that are empirically proven to be much more predictive of creditworthiness for these consumers.
